description_en: Upgrades the minor engine version of a PolarDB on ENS cluster
description_zh: PolarDB边缘云集群小版本升级
name: UpgradeDBClusterVersionZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB on ENS cluster. Only cluster IDs returned by the DescribeDBClustersZonal operation are supported. Before you call this operation, you must create an edge cluster by using ENS infrastructure. Standard PolarDB cluster IDs are not supported. Note: Only edge cluster IDs returned by DescribeDBClustersZonal are accepted, and the edge cluster must be created based on ENS
parameters.help_zh: 边缘云集群 ID，仅接受 DescribeDBClustersZonal 返回的集群 ID。调用前需先通过 ENS 基础设施创建边缘集群；普通 PolarDB 集群 ID 不适用。调用说明：仅接受通过 DescribeDBClustersZonal 返回的边缘云集群 ID，并在前置条件中补充边缘集群创建依赖 ENS 的说明
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The kernel version upgrade policy. Valid values:

HOT: Hot upgrade.

COLD: Cold upgrade. Only PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 Cluster Edition supports this upgrade method
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级策略。取值范围如下：

HOT：热升级

COLD：冷升级。目前仅PolarDB MySQL版8.0集群版支持该升级方式
parameters.name: upgrade_policy

parameters.help_en:
The kernel version upgrade label. Set the value to INNOVATE.

This parameter applies only to upgrades from PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.1 to PolarDB for MySQL 8.0.2.
If you specify this parameter, you must set `UpgradePolicy` to COLD
parameters.help_zh:
内核版本升级标签。取值固定为INNOVATE。

该参数仅适用于PolarDB MySQL版8.0.1版本升级至PolarDB MySQL版8.0.2版本。
当传入该参数时，`UpgradePolicy`必须传入COLD
parameters.name: upgrade_label

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time to start the scheduled Milvus version upgrade task. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
The start time must be within the next 24 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, the allowed start time ranges from `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`.
If you leave this parameter empty, the Milvus version upgrade task is immediately executed by default
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）内核版本升级任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
开始时间的取值范围为未来24小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-15T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行内核版本升级任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest time to start the scheduled task. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
The latest time must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If you specify `PlannedStartTime` but do not specify this parameter, the latest time to start the task defaults to 30 minutes after the start time. For example, if you set `PlannedStartTime` to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and leave this parameter empty, the task starts at `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z` at the latest
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately execute or schedule the kernel version upgrade. Valid values:

false (default): Scheduled execution.

true: Immediate execution.

You do not need to specify this parameter when you invoke this operation
parameters.help_zh:
立即执行或定时执行内核版本升级。取值范围如下：

false（默认值）：定时执行

true：立即执行

调用该接口时无需使用该参数
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade type. Valid values:

PROXY: Upgrades only PolarProxy.

DB: Upgrades only the database engine.

ALL (default): Upgrades both PolarProxy and the database engine
parameters.help_zh:
升级类型。取值范围如下：

PROXY：仅升级数据库代理（Proxy）

DB：仅升级内核引擎

ALL（默认值）：同时升级数据库代理（Proxy）和内核引擎
parameters.name: upgrade_type

parameters.help_en: The version code of the target database engine version. You can obtain the value from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DB目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_db_revision_version_code

parameters.help_en: The version code of the target PolarProxy version. You can obtain the value from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html operation
parameters.help_zh: Proxy目标版本的VersionCode，参数取值可从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319145.html接口获取
parameters.name: target_proxy_revision_version_code

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and is case-sensitive. It can contain up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
